plan.name: Work each ratified plan of issues every poll
plan.summary: Each poll, the watcher hands `WorkPlan` the plan on every open issue whose state is a ratified plan of issues, exactly as ratified: the issue, the proposal's hash, the writer whose `/invariant ratify` the ratified post answers, that comment's URL, and the plan's issues in order. That is the issue's whole step, so it builds nothing of its own and answers no command but `/invariant stop`, which `WorkPlan` answers; once the issue holds the post saying that plan is done, it gets no step at all. If no writer's ratify is found there, as when the ratifier can no longer write, `WorkPlan` gets the plan with no ratifier, and the proved core opens nothing more. Forks, revisions, ratification, stops, crash recovery, the lease and `WorkPlan` itself stay as #139 and #144 have them. SPEC.md, docs/PRD.md and the README, in its slice 13 line and with rows for `/invariant plan` and `/invariant stop` in its table of commands, say the factory now works the plans `/invariant plan` ratifies, and that a first real PRD end to end is next.

tests.name: TestARatifiedPlanOpensItsFirstIssueOnTheNextPoll
tests.says: A plan of three issues, drafted with /invariant plan and ratified by @gitdek, opens its first issue on the next poll, titled as its first step and naming the plan's issue and the ratifying comment, recorded there under the plan's hash and @gitdek, and taken as @gitdek's; the second opens only once the first has merged, and the plan's issue opens no pull request of its own.

tests.name: TestAStopOnARatifiedPlanOpensNothingMore
tests.says: After a writer's /invariant stop on a ratified plan's issue, answered once, the issue already open merges through the factory, nothing more opens, and the plan isn't said to be done.

tests.name: TestAPlanThatIsntRatifiedOpensNothing
tests.says: A proposed plan of issues opens nothing over several polls, even after a reader's ratify and a writer's ratify that names another hash; once a writer ratifies it, the next poll opens its first issue.

tests.name: TestADonePlansIssueGetsNoMoreSteps
tests.says: Once all three of a plan's issues have merged through the factory, its issue says the plan is done once, naming each, and then gets no more steps: a writer's /invariant stop there goes unanswered, and nothing more opens.
